title: Brand Journey: continuity across organisational boundaries
summary: Brand Journey models the customer-facing experience across support, delivery, billing and sales while staying outside CRM, identity correlation and telemetry. It retains context loss, repeated-explanation burden, unresolved service state and later recovery without allowing recovery to erase prior failure.
invariants: External correlation supplies relationship continuity; Brand Journey does not discover customer identity.
relationshipRef is protected; journey residue is privacy-minimised.
Service as Sales means brand/commercial relationship work, not an upsell mandate.
A later recovery does not erase earlier context loss.
Brand Journey does not grant sales or action authority.

provenance.claim: Brand Journey scope across organisational boundaries and explicit non-CRM/non-causal boundary.
